gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta reads smooth and approachable, its big x-height and unthinned curves keeping every word friendly and quick to take in. Outrun Future supplies the swagger, wide-set and synthwave to the bone.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lexend-tera: Contemporary and clean, Lexend Tera spaces its single-weight letters like stepping stones beneath the authoritative Outrun Future heading. Both are wide-set, so the two feel related, one loud, one hushed.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-montserrat-a: Neon-era swagger: Outrun Future spreads its constant-width outlines wide across the line. Montserrat Alternates huddles its lowercase up toward the capital line, which makes the two feel pleasantly mismatched, one stretched, one snug.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono is a sans-serif with curves matching its stems, each letter planted like a pin opposite heavy Plakkaat. Line after line it ticks along, open where the heading is closed.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-lexend-giga: Plakkaat brings closed, heavy letters whose terminals curl nearly back to the stem, a bold shout up top. Lexend Giga stays flat and single-weight, its generous tracking letting paragraphs unspool without strain.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-lexend-mega: Plakkaat is all weight, its bent-straw lines curling round until the terminals nearly touch the stem. Lexend Mega draws everything with one nib and leaves a gap in every c, so text moves along easily.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-montserrat-alterna: Light, loose, techy: Quantum spaces its letters out and keeps every mouth open. Montserrat Alternates, a sans-serif with chalk-board lowercase crowding the capital line, reads snugly and steadily across a page of text.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-lexend-exa: Wide and geometric, Redux enters each curve with a visible flourish. Lexend Exa has no stress in its open curves and stubby ascenders, so text moves along in a steady, uniform line.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-lexend-mega: Redux spaces itself wide and tapers gently from stem to joint, giving headings a geometric flourish at every curve. Lexend Mega keeps its nib-drawn strokes unpinched, built for sustained reading.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-lexend-zetta: Spacious, geometric, quietly theatrical: that is Redux up top. Lexend Zetta adds widely tracked, tall-bodied letters cut at constant width, so the two stretch across a line in step.
